cardsWithIssues.target: Quando entrò nella stanza, vide che tutto era cambiato.
cardsWithIssues.english: When he entered the room, he saw that everything had changed.

cardsWithIssues.target: Si alzò in piedi, guardò l'assemblea e cominciò a parlare.
cardsWithIssues.english: He stood up, looked at the assembly, and began to speak.
cardsWithIssues.grammar: Narrative chains use passato remoto for sequential actions in formal writing.

cardsWithIssues.target: Prese il cappotto, salutò tutti e uscì senza dire una parola.
cardsWithIssues.english: He grabbed his coat, greeted everyone, and left without saying a word.

cardsWithIssues.target: Andò alla finestra, aprì le imposte e respirò l'aria fresca.
cardsWithIssues.english: She went to the window, opened the shutters, and breathed the fresh air.

cardsWithIssues.target: Partì all'alba e non fece mai più ritorno a casa.
cardsWithIssues.english: He left at dawn and never came back home again.
cardsWithIssues.grammar: Irregular forms: partire → parti, fare → fece.

cardsWithIssues.target: Presero una decisione difficile che cambiò il corso degli eventi.
cardsWithIssues.english: They made a difficult decision that changed the course of events.

cardsWithIssues.target: L'onorevole ha dichiarato che si procederà con le riforme annunciate.
cardsWithIssues.english: The Honorable Member declared that they would proceed with the announced reforms.

cardsWithIssues.target: Morì in solitudine, lontano dalla terra che aveva tanto amato.
cardsWithIssues.english: He died in solitude, far from the land he had loved so much.

cardsWithIssues.target: L'esercito attraversò il fiume durante la notte senza essere scoperto.
cardsWithIssues.english: The army crossed the river during the night without being discovered.

cardsWithIssues.target: Qualora lo ritenesse opportuno, potrà contattarci in qualsiasi momento.
cardsWithIssues.english: Should you deem it appropriate, you may contact us at any time.

cardsWithIssues.target: Queste cose, non le capirò mai per quanto ci provi.
cardsWithIssues.english: These things, I'll never understand them no matter how hard I try.

cardsWithIssues.target: È evidente che, a meno che non si intervenga, la situazione peggiorerà.
cardsWithIssues.english: It is evident that, unless action is taken, the situation will worsen.
